$comment: Single source of truth for Nexus Core DevOps gates (scripts/devops, scripts/org-init, CI). activeModules deploy to the headless scratch org (CI); fullProfileModules need the full org shape (setup-scratch-headless.sh --profile full) and are covered by the static gates only.

deployStages.$comment: Full-profile modules deploy in these stages (directory names, or paths relative to the module), then whole. OmniStudio validates references at deploy time; a site's guest profile and guest sharing rules exist only once the site does.
